command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_thermal*.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Two insulated unit slabs with k=C=1, beta=1.1, contact conductance G=beta*tan(beta)/2. Initial left T=300+70*cos(beta*x); right T=300-70*cos(beta*(2-x)). Both perturbations decay as exp(-beta²*t). Compare contact entropy from computed Q4 histories to the exact integral; independently compare total integrated C*log(T/T0) to bulk conduction and contact entropy production. CPU float64, dense/sparse Crank-Nicolson, 8/16/32 cells per side and matching number of time intervals through 0.4 s.
